expectations.text: Flags the nested comments and attachments resolvers as unscoped by tenant
expectations.evidence: "comments, attachments, and author query solely by IDs from parent" without tenant constraints

expectations.text: Flags updateDocument for scoping on id alone without a tenant constraint
expectations.evidence: "updateDocument takes a session but updates only by document ID"

expectations.text: Flags exportWorkspace taking tenantId from the client-controlled request body
expectations.evidence: "exportWorkspace trusts req.body.tenantId, so any caller can request another tenant's export"

expectations.text: Flags searchDocuments as returning rows across all tenants
expectations.evidence: "searchDocuments accepts a session but never applies session.tenantId. A search can return matching titles/IDs from every tenant."

expectations.text: Flags adminListDocuments as checking authentication but not authorization or tenant
expectations.evidence: "Any signed-in user receives the latest 200 documents across all tenants"

expectations.text: Enumerates all the affected sites rather than fixing only the first one found
expectations.evidence: Five distinct findings: export, search, admin, update, and nested resolvers

expectations.text: Recommends a structural device (scoped repository, row-level security, or equivalent) rather than only adding where-clauses site by site
Recommends a cross-tenant test that attempts tenant A operations against tenant B resources
expectations.evidence: "add a table-driven two-tenant test for every operation, asserting tenant A gets a 404/no rows when targeting tenant B"

expectations.text: Identifies the raw interpolation of tenantId into $queryRawUnsafe as an injection hazard distinct in kind from the tenant-scoping bug
expectations.evidence: "interpolates that value into $queryRawUnsafe, allowing the tenant predicate to be altered entirely"; title divides into "request body + SQL injection"

expectations.text: Does not conclude the main query paths being scoped means the service is safe
expectations.evidence: "that does not protect raw SQL, update, search, admin, or associations"
